meta.host: reference host — Intel i9-12900F, 24 threads, 30 MiB L3, Linux 6.8
meta.method: benches/bench_memtable.cc built -O3 against release libexpanse.so; one `bench_memtable --arm <phase> --round N` process per cell, phases interleaved within each round; 5 rounds, mean with BCa 95% bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples, seed 42) and paired per-round ratio intervals, driven by docs/benchmarks/rocksdb_memtable/scripts/single_threaded_bench.py into docs/benchmarks/rocksdb_memtable/results/baseline_rocksdb.json. This chart renders run 1; run 2 is docs/benchmarks/rocksdb_memtable/results/baseline_rocksdb_run2.json
meta.retraction_372_discharged: The commit-7d87dff7 run measured its skiplist arm against a strawman Node embedding all 16 tower pointers statically (~146.7 B/entry); that density figure and the derived 11.1x headline were retracted (#372). Density was re-measured first with the fair variable-height node (8 B key ptr + height*8 B tower, E[height]=4/3), and is unchanged by the re-run below (deterministic byte accounting). The wall-clock cells were then re-measured against that same fair baseline (run 33398474866, #382 item 5) at commit 6cb64b45, and every wall-clock figure from that run is superseded in turn: the cells here are run 1 of the two 7cd5140e runs taken through the provenance-bearing driver (#868), which also changed the process boundary to one phase per invocation and the ratio estimator to a paired per-round quotient. Nothing here is pending.
